editionLabel: Z-Man Games English original edition rulebook (2008)
firstPlayerRule: Players choose the starting player, who takes the starting player marker and two food. The other players each receive three food.
clarifications: During the work phase, players place family members one at a time clockwise from the marker holder. The marker does not rotate automatically; the Starting Player action changes it.
